pools-v1.0.0.description: _A liminal horror game about exploring eerie pools and maze-like spaces by Tensori_ **Randomizer Features** - Adding a form of gameplay to a game without any! - All 6 Levels + Level 0 are supported - Goal: Collect enough Rubber Ducks and complete Level 6 - Option to exclude Level 0 - Option to exclude Chair Locations - 4 unique traps to experience with configurable weights and durations - Scales well for all types of multiworlds: Short / Long Syncs, Asyncs; 198-333 checks - Custom client UI that displays important information and updates in real-time - No manual mod installation required! The Archipelago client hooks into the game at runtime. Nothing else to download, install, or configure. - Feature-complete and considered stable **Locations** - Entering Pools - Going Down Slides - Standing on Diving Boards - Sitting on Chairs - Touching Props - Triggering Special Interactions / Events **Items** - Level Unlocks - Pool Depths (1-11 Tiles High) - Slide Colors - Diving Boards - Chair Types - Run - Progressive Movement Speed - Progressive Water Speed **Setup Guide:** [Here](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/blob/pools/worlds/pools/docs/setup_en.md)
